ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) distribution; high-intensity (white) pixels represent approximately 15% of the surface area, clustered on the distal right lobe.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity mottle-pattern mapped to the distal 25% of the right lobe; remainder of fluke surface shows uniform low-intensity pixel mapping.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a clear vertex; depth is approximately 20% of the maximum lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge displays low-amplitude, high-frequency serrations; right lobe features a singular large-scale concave indentation midway between notch and tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curves along the posterior lobe margins, transitioning to a slight posterior-facing hook at the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially dense clusters of high-intensity circular pixel patterns located at the extreme distal tips of both fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant irregular notch on the trailing edge of the right lobe and a singular isolated high-intensity circular pixel spot on the lower-mid right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast biological encrustation on the lateral margins, creating a textured protrusion from the fluke's primary geometric outline.
